command: set -eu; dpkg-query -W apt libapt-pkg6.0 libkrb5-3 libsqlite3-0 zlib1g; echo KDC_BINARIES; for p in krb5kdc kadmind kadmin.local sqlite3; do command -v "$p" || true; done; echo DATABASE_LIBRARIES; ldd /usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin/postgres; echo GOSU_VERSION; gosu --version; echo PG_VERSION; postgres --version
